Card Q&A.a: If a Digi-Egg card is affected by an effect that places it at the bottom of the deck, it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to Digi-Egg cards in the trash when this card's [On Play][When Digivolving] effect activates?

Does "if this effect returned level 7 white cards" in this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect mean that it will activate even if I return a card such as BT12-112 [Shoutmon X7: Superior Mode] that has 2 or more colors including white?
Do I gain 6 memory if I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to return 2 level 7 white cards?

Card Q&A.a: The player that activated the effect chooses themselves or their opponent, then all of the cards in the chosen player's trash are returned to the bottom of the deck.
Card Q&A.q: Which player returns cards from their trash to the bottom of the deck for this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)

[On Play][When Digivolving] Trash all digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return all cards in your or your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck. If this effect returned level 7 white cards, gain 3 memory.
[When Attacking] By returning 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, unsuspend this Digimon.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 5 memory.)
